name: boilersuit
description: Use this skill when a project provides Boilersuit generators or when creating repeatable files from a Boilersuit boilerplate. Covers inspecting project support, listing and describing generators, previewing planned files, and only generating after preview.
when: When using Boilersuit generators for repeatable file generation
do-not-use-when: Creating a one-off bespoke file where a generator would add overhead
Editing existing code without adding a repeatable structure
The project has no Boilersuit generators and no boilerplate setup task
